title: Learn directly from a small customer group
approach: Plan a few direct customer conversations around your key uncertainty. Record what changed your understanding and what remains unknown.
interpretation: Editorial interpretation of the dated facts, not advice published by the company or investor.
caution: Selected success stories have survivorship bias. Adapt the method to your context; historical counts are not targets.

title: Try a bounded local service
approach: Choose one small service area and a narrow offer you can safely deliver. Record requests, completed service and operational problems before expanding. Decide the scope and stop conditions yourself.
interpretation: Original editorial learning prompt based on the limited dated facts, not company or investor advice.
caution: A selected surviving company is not evidence of causation or a success guarantee. Define your own limits and stop conditions; historical activity is not a target.

title: Test one workflow you know
approach: Identify one concrete problem in a workflow you experience directly. Build the smallest test of the difficult part, record what works and fails, and seek external user evidence separately before inferring demand.
interpretation: Original editorial learning prompt based on the limited dated facts, not company or investor advice.
caution: A selected surviving company is not evidence of causation or a success guarantee. Define your own limits and stop conditions; historical activity is not a target.
